_about: The Parts panel controls as they shipped at b35a2af (GU names via gu_parts.py + PART_UI), frozen 2026-10-20 by Raven's rule "Leave the part names and hit zones names alone since I will need to manually label them": build_viewer.py starts from these instead of re-reading GU's part-review.json, so no name changes unless edited here by hand. Extended 2026-10-25 (Raven: "For monsters found in GU, can you see if the part ids match. If they do, can you assign part labels accordingly?"): gu_parts.py --extend-frozen added the GU names of controls left unnamed, matching parts by id and place (the vertex rule dropped); no name already here was changed.
